crossRefs.note: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.
Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.
Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more…
Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received…
Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,
I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle…
I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before…
But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show…
There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but…
Israel will be saved by Yahweh with an everlasting salvation. You will not be disappointed nor confounded to ages…
All the offspring of Israel will be justified in Yahweh, and will rejoice!
He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.
In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear…
Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and…
Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become…
For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,
For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision amounts to anything, nor uncircumcision, but faith working through love.
For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.
For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in…
By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.
We know that the Son of God has come, and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true, and we are in…

people.name: Andronicus
people.line: Fellow prisoner with Paul, outstanding among the apostles

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Junia
people.line: A prominent apostle and relative of Paul

translations.web: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.
translations.bsb: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my fellow countrymen and fellow prisoners. They are outstanding among the apostles, and they were in Christ before I was.
translations.kjv: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellowprisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
translations.asv: Salute Andronicus and Junias, my kinsmen, and my fellow-prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also have been in Christ before me.
